Name: CtrlAltZero
Author: FallSpice1
Description:
CtrlAltZero adds the four main characters from a story I'm working on into Stardew Valley.

Alta is a distant, introverted young woman with a bad leg and a fuzzy grasp on life. She's struggling with adapting to a cane, but she's too proud to ask for help.
Zero's a feral little freak who eats batteries. Surprisingly, he's got no issues. Together they can save the world. Or something.
Sylvia's on that Barbie sigma grindset. She strives for perfection in anything she does. Is there anything she [i]can't[/i] do?
Rowan? Nobody knows exactly what's up with Rowan. Maybe you can find out.

Features:
[list]
[*]Adds eight new cooking recipes, including drinkable battery acid
[*]Adds one new NPC (Alta) to begin with. Zero will come to stay at 4 hearts.
[*]Adds two new dateable NPCs (Rowan and Sylvia.) They are unlocked after completing the "Sanders Siblings" quest, which you get at 4 hearts with Zero.
[*]Adds a new location (the Feywild,) unlocked with Rowan and Sylvia.
[*]DO NOT TRY TO DATE BOTH SIBLINGS AT THE SAME TIME. BAD THINGS WILL HAPPEN.
[/list]
I made the whole mod myself with no prior modding experience. That includes code and assets.

There might be a few bugs, because I'm seventeen, a new coder, and made the whole base mod in two weeks. I am still patching out any bugs that I find, so please submit bug reports. I will try to reply as quickly as possible.

CONTENT WARNINGS:
- Depression (implied)
- Eating disorder/bad relationship with food (very briefly implied)
- Mild curse substitutes, nothing worse than vanilla
- Really terrible parents (discussed, not in-depth)
